instruction: Chrome keeps showing me notifications from websites and it's really annoying. How do I turn off all website notifications?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"session":{"restore_on_startup":4, "startup_urls":["http://funbrain.com/"]}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences

metadata.explanation: Task requires blocking all website notifications in Chrome settings. Similar to original task - navigate to Settings > Privacy and security > Site settings > Notifications and set to 'Don't allow sites to send notifications'.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if notifications blocked (default_content_setting_values.notifications=2 in Preferences), 0.0 otherwise

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and checks if notifications are blocked (value=2)
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares getter result ('true'/'false') with expected value ('true')
Expected value semantically correct: 'true' means notifications are blocked globally
Evaluator fully covers instruction requirement: turning off all website notifications
Getter has appropriate error handling (returns 'false' on error)
Minor concern: Chrome preferences may not be immediately flushed to disk after UI changes, though Chrome typically auto-saves settings
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding postconfig to ensure Chrome preferences are saved (e.g., close Chrome or add delay)
